description_short.value: Ghanaian Depositary Shares in AngloGold Ashanti plc: 100 depositary shares represent one ordinary share, giving Ghanaian investors a low-priced way to hold the gold miner.
description_short.source: Written by us from the AngloGold Ashanti 2025 annual report (corporate directory: Ghanaian Depositary Shares, ratio 100 GhDSs to one ordinary share, depositary NTHC Limited) and the AngloGold Ashanti release of 26 September 2023 (GSE PR 349/2023)

description_full.value: These are Ghanaian Depositary Shares (GhDSs) of AngloGold Ashanti plc, the gold miner whose ordinary shares trade on the Ghana Stock Exchange as AGA. Each ordinary share is represented by 100 GhDSs, held by NTHC Limited as depositary, so one GhDS carries a hundredth of an ordinary share's economic interest and is priced in cedis at roughly a hundredth of it. The exchange lists them under the code AAD. Depositary shares were first listed on the GSE for AngloGold Ashanti Limited after its 2004 merger with Ashanti Goldfields. When the group moved its domicile from South Africa to the United Kingdom in September 2023, those were delisted and replaced by GhDSs of the new UK parent, AngloGold Ashanti plc, which began trading on 26 September 2023. The company reports and declares dividends in US dollars on its ordinary shares; its business, board and financial results are those of AGA.
description_full.source: Written by us from the AngloGold Ashanti 2025 annual report (corporate directory: GhSE codes AGA and AAD, GhDS ratio and depositary), the abridged pre-listing statement for the 2023 reorganisation (GSE PR 258/2023: delisting of the AGA Limited GhDSs and listing of the new plc's GhDSs), the AngloGold Ashanti release of 26 September 2023 (GSE PR 349/2023) and the GSE listed-company page for AADs (2004 listing of the predecessor's depositary shares)
